recommended.variant: Native input type=checkbox with an associated visible label, native checked, and fieldset/legend for groups.

entries.behavior: APG requires an accessible name, checkbox role, Space activation, and synchronized checked state; native HTML supplies these without a custom host.
entries.source_date: living document; no publication date shown
entries.decision: Use native checkbox and label; use custom ARIA only when native semantics cannot fit.

entries.behavior: CANDIDATE Checkbox Example (Two State) report: 96 MUST assertions passed and 6 failed; no negative side effects recorded. This is the custom APG comparison baseline, not a native-checkbox result. MUST counts exclude ARIA-AT's per-command negative-side-effect assertions; side effects are reported separately.
entries.decision: Retain native checkbox and use ARIA-AT to identify custom-state assertion risks.

entries.behavior: NVDA 12718 reports that a role=group description was not announced for a checkbox group in browse mode. The same issue says radio buttons behaved as expected because focus mode reads the description.
entries.decision: Do not make essential checkbox-group instructions available only through a group description; do not transfer this failure to radios.
